hint.label: Personification
hint.text:
Personification is the attribution of human traits to things which are not human.

For example:
The wind howled.
hint.sound: ssml: Personification is the attribution of human traits to things which are not human. For example: The wind howled.

instruction.text: Which picture matches the personification in the sentence?

atoms.a: The wind softly whispered in her ear.
The fish were dancing around the coral.
